## What

A short description of the change and why it exists. Link any issue.

## How to verify

- [ ] `bun run test` passes (affected packages at minimum)
- [ ] `bun run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `bun run lint` clean
- [ ] `bun run format:check` passes

## Notes

Anything reviewers should know: behavior changes, migration concerns, docs
that need updating, or follow-ups this enables.
